name: Best Undiscovered Indie Rock Radio (Kevin Graham)
instructions: Description: 'Submissions: for best results, contact me directly on kegraham@yahoo.com'. Send Spotify link + short bio.
notes: Curator: Kevin. Indie and alt rock from undiscovered artists. Same curator as Radio Wigwam (existing) — one email can pitch both his playlists. ~1.5K saves per search snippet.

name: Best Indie Rock and Pop Unsigned (Kevin Graham)
instructions: Description: 'Submissions: for best results, contact me directly on kegraham@yahoo.com'. Unsigned acts only.
notes: Curator: Kevin. Unsigned indie rock/pop. Pitch together with Best Undiscovered Indie Rock Radio in one email.

name: UKI (Kevin Mann)
instructions: Submit via the curator's Groover profile (UK Independent; alt rock and indie rock listed). Paid Groover credits.
notes: Curator: Kevin. 'Showcasing Tomorrows Independent Music Today'; linked UKI radio show.

name: UK DIY PUNK (TNS Records)
instructions: Playlist description says submit via the TNS Records contact page. Choose the reason 'Can you feature my band on your Spotify playlists?' and give band name, Spotify profile URL, the song for consideration and a note about the song.
notes: Curator: TNS Records (Manchester DIY punk label). Focuses on the UK DIY punk scene. Free route.

name: adventures in post-punk (AnalogueTrash)
instructions: Submit via AnalogueTrash's SubmitHub page, linked as 'Send Us Music' on their playlists page.
notes: Curator: AnalogueTrash (new music blog, Todmorden, West Yorkshire). They also run Adventures in Indie Rock and Adventures in Shoegaze. SubmitHub may offer a free standard credit, but that isn't confirmed.

name: Big Rock Bangers - Rock / Alternative (Kool Playlists)
notes: Curator: unknown first name (Kool Playlists). UK inferred from address only. Broad rock/alt incl. heavier stuff.

name: INDIE HOTLIST (indiemusicnation)
instructions: Submit via Groover profile Indie Music Nation (paid). IG @indiemusicnationofficial in description.
notes: Curator: unknown first name. Listed under Groover UK tag. Indie / post-punk leaning.

name: Misfits' Alternative Tracks (Music For The Misfits)
instructions: Contact page: 'For reviews: reviews@musicforthemisfits.com'; blog submissions also via SubmitHub or Musosoup; Groover profile says accepted tracks can go on their Spotify playlists.
notes: Curator: Laura. Newcastle-based indie blog; playlist placement follows blog coverage. Activity may have slowed (last confirmed posts early 2025).

name: Misfits' Newest Releases (Music For The Misfits)
instructions: Same route as above: reviews@musicforthemisfits.com, or SubmitHub/Musosoup for the blog. This playlist is the one linked from the contact page.
notes: Curator: Laura. All-genre new-releases list, so less rock-specific.

name: Constant Bangover - Punk Rock Skate Hardcore (Lockjaw Records)
instructions: Label contact page, 'Sending us music': 'We love hearing new music. Please include streaming links rather than attaching large audio files!' Use the form with enquiry type 'Demo submission'.
notes: UK DIY punk/hardcore label; playlist curated by label team (label bands + favourites). Route is a label demo form, not a playlist-specific pitch.

name: BOOT MAGAZINE: TOP 100 (BOOT Magazine)
instructions: Use the 'Submit your music' artist submission form on the magazine's Submit page (free, no guaranteed reply). They also offer SubmitHub for a guaranteed response, which is paid.
notes: Liverpool/Manchester music magazine. The playlist is their 'top 100 new releases' (indie/post-punk leaning). The form is for magazine coverage, so the playlist isn't explicitly named.

name: G.R.I.T (athenvalefan)
instructions: Free submission via Soundplate page; alt IG @athenvale.
notes: Curator: unknown first name. Follower count from Soundplate page, not Spotify. Gritty rock/grunge; country unknown.

name: UK + IE Best Rock 2025 (UK Best Playlists)
instructions: Description lists ukbestplaylists@gmail.com but does not explicitly invite submissions.
notes: Curator: unknown first name. 2025 edition (~6.7K saves per snippet); mostly established acts, may be commercial.
